widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the 35-year-old Asian office worker whose appearance comes from <Picture 1>, the supplied character portrait: short neat black hair with a light side part, thin rectangular metal-frame glasses, calm gentle features, clean-shaven; wearing a light-blue button-up dress shirt, dark charcoal trousers, a black leather belt, and a slim black wristwatch; rendered as a photorealistic 3D character with subsurface-scattering skin and soft key lighting.

summary:
[reference generation] The clip opens a one-take day-in-the-life video: a single unbroken shot shows <Subject 1> finishing his morning toothbrushing in his apartment bathroom, then walking out toward the front door.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears throughout the clip): fully_preserved - the man's hairstyle, glasses, face, skin texture, and light-blue shirt exactly follow <Picture 1>.

detailed_description:
The clip uses a photorealistic 3D CG cinematic style with subsurface-scattering skin, soft cool morning window light, and gentle shallow depth of field. There is no dialogue.
[Shot 1] One continuous unbroken take, no cuts and no transitions: a medium tracking shot frames <Subject 1>, the 35-year-old Asian office worker with short neat black hair, thin rectangular metal-frame glasses, and a light-blue button-up dress shirt, from a three-quarter angle as he stands at the sink of a bright, modern apartment bathroom. His tired-but-calm face is reflected in the round mirror while he brushes his teeth with a steady rhythm; cool daylight enters through a frosted window and softens on his skin. He rinses, sets the toothbrush in the cup, wipes his mouth with a towel, and pushes his glasses back up with a small composed breath. The camera keeps the same continuous tracking motion as he turns and leaves the bathroom; the clip ends mid-step behind him in the hallway, the apartment's front door visible ahead of him in the frame.

overall_soundscape:
A soft electric toothbrush hum and gentle running water over quiet morning apartment room tone; light footsteps and the rustle of shirt fabric as he walks out. No speech.

non_diegetic_music:
A slow solo-piano motif at soft volume, sparse and unhurried, with no dynamic swell, fading out in the final second.
